calibratedMetaDescription: Compare redundancy vs settlement agreements under April 2026 rates (£751/wk cap, £30k tax exemption). Check your legal rights and severance payout now.
faqQuestion: How do redundancy and settlement agreements differ under UK employment law?
faqAnswer: Under Section 135 and 162 of the Employment Rights Act 1996, statutory redundancy is capped at £751 per week, while genuine compensation up to £30,000 is tax-free under Section 403 of ITEPA 2003. Ordinary unfair dismissal claims are subject to a compensatory cap of £123,543.
